title: Codex-Security Feature Port — Implementation Plan
summary: Task-by-task TDD plan to port six signal/recall mechanisms from codex-security into sec-overlay without touching the frozen Go contract.
notes: Implementation plan with checkbox tasks, code snippets, and global constraints. Contains SPEC-like interface definitions (e.g. graph.symbol_at signature) but dominant structure is a step-by-step execution plan, not a contract document → DOC. No frontmatter, no status field, no user stories. Hash suffix in filename is a placeholder (no shell available to compute SHA-256).
